title: De-flake flow-reuse-opens-without-model.spec.js — the stub loses a race
description: This test reddened master on 2026-08-28 (run 33196261338) and a rerun of the IDENTICAL commit came back green, so it is a race, not logic. Mechanism, traced: the spec stubs `state.s_installedModelIds` four times in one page and asserts on the toast each time. Case 1 (installed ['klein-4b'], recorded ['klein-9b']) PASSED and case 4 (installed ['klein-4b'], recorded undefined) FAILED in the same run — identical state, opposite outcomes, which is the proof it is timing. js/shell.js:1540 is the only writer of `s_installedModelIds` and refreshes it asynchronously from the backend; on a CI runner with nothing installed it resolves to [] and lands mid-suite, so flowAvailability (js/data/flowsRegistry.js:2163) then reports the model missing and _reuseModelToast (js/services/flowService.js:216) fires the danger toast case 4 asserts must not exist. It passes locally only because the real models ARE installed here, which is also why `npm test` cannot see it — this is the desktop Playwright suite. Fix by making the stub authoritative for the test's lifetime (suppress or await the refresh) rather than assigning and racing it; do NOT widen the 80ms sleep, that just moves the flake. Verify by running the spec against an EMPTY installed set, which is the CI condition and currently reproduces nothing locally.
